source_name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (PLACES)
dataset: PLACES county estimates, 2025 release, crude prevalence
notes: MODEL-BASED estimate. Each county value is a prediction from a multilevel model fitted to BRFSS and poststratified against Census population and ACS covariates; it is not a measurement taken in that county, and a county may contribute no BRFSS respondents at all.
The published interval is a modelled credible interval, not a sampling margin of error. It is not comparable to an ACS MOE.
Standard errors here are recovered from the interval assuming symmetry. Worst observed asymmetry in this pull: 2.000 percentage points.
Measures within one release may rest on different BRFSS years: the 2025 release uses 2023 BRFSS for 35 measures and 2022 for 5. A single release is not a single vintage.
Do not rank counties on these estimates. Handbook §7.2 measures the consequence: 0 of 2,956 counties have a determined rank, including for a measure whose reliability is 0.87.
